summary: Sandbach United are in final preparations for the 2026/27 season, which kicks off in just one week, with several exciting new signings and at least one returning player bolstering the squad. The Ramblers are looking sharp in their pre-season campaign, though they fell to St Helens in a tight match where their opponents made the most of their chances. With three brand new kits on the way and promotion on the agenda, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship partners to support what looks to be an ambitious season ahead.
